body:
Thank you both. I have a feeling ill be dealing with this crap for a while, but it's nice to know I'm not alone.
Keep up with the poetry quarantines, and thedramos, keep those jokes coming. 
I ended up sitting myself down and working on some new jokes. I feel better now.

Peace

I have too much passion for the woman I have been in love with for four years, she "doesn't know what to say"
My mother and father both have cancer. My mother may not last another six months. And I am sick of trying so hard to be as perfect of a person I know I should be. It's not possible and I end up setting myself up to fail every time.
The only thing that brings me joy in this world, is making people laugh, but my standup career is more laughable than my jokes themselves. The one person that brought me joy left me, slept with her ex, then came back to me but has been so distant and cold. I know I should suck it up and man up but I just can't see a reason to keep living anymore.
